This is a synthetic fixture made from the full official libwdi v1.5.1 WinUSB template. It is not a captured Windows file or an installation package. Placeholders are replaced using the same target construction as libwdi, then encoded as UTF-16LE with BOM as wdi_prepare_driver writes it. The original LGPL copyright comment is retained; license and source are in usbnet/licenses and usbnet/third-party.
